name: 学習モジュールの選択
prompt:
Create ONE isolated Japanese module selector. Input1 ORIGINAL Coursera screenshot is PRIMARY for circular state-indicator anatomy, half-filled circle geometry, pill proportions, optical strokes, spacing and alignment. Input2 Japanese native mock is SECONDARY exact wording/type roles and six visible modules; its solid white selected dot loses the original half-filled state. Input3 official Lighthouse finish only; no bus.
Only source x48 y514 width1131 height206 in1179x2676. No course header, progress summary, lesson cards or other content. Pure white390x84 logical canvas, compact layout.
Top-left atx16,y8 exact「モジュール」Meiryo BOLD14px line24, zero spacing, dark #1D1D1D.
At y42 one row of six rounded pill controls60x32 radius16, narrow consistent2px gaps, containing module numbers「1」「2」「3」「4」「5」「6」in order. ALL numbers Meiryo REGULAR40012px line16, zero spacing, no bold. Keep six numbers fully readable as native mock.
First pill selected: official forest gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E instead of original black, white numeral1. At left restore source circle about14px: WHITE OUTLINE around full circle, LEFT HALF filled white, RIGHT HALF clear showing forest background. The vertical half boundary is centered. It must be visibly HALF-filled, NOT a solid white dot, not a checkmark, not an arbitrary percentage wedge. Preserve exact visible source state without interpreting its meaning.
Remaining five pills WHITE fill with fine neutral gray outline, dark numerals, small empty14px circles with thin slate #526173 outline atleft. Original circle optical weight, not thick rings. Vertically align icon and numeral centers. No extra selected pills, no mint, no shadow, no caption or English. Ordinary white surfaces, selected forest only. High-resolution flat UI raster.
reviewNotes: Inspected six modules1–6 in order, first forest-selected with restored left-white/right-clear half-circle, five white unselected pills with slate empty rings, exact Japanese heading and Regular numerals. Visible source state preserved without completion-percent inference. Native font metrics/module interactions unproven; raster visual review only.
